# Plugin outbound-request header policy: the shared case table.
#
# CANONICAL COPY: hellohq-wasm-runtime tests/fixtures/plugin_request_policy_cases.txt
# VENDORED COPY:  hellohq test/fixtures/plugin_request_policy_cases.txt (byte-identical)
#
# Read by BOTH policy implementations' tests:
#   - Rust: src/request_policy.rs (shared_case_table_*), applied on the in-host
#     wasi:http@0.2 path (src/wasi_guests.rs GatedHttpHooks);
#   - Dart: hellohq lib/app/utils/service/plugin_request_policy.dart
#     (PluginRequestPolicy), applied in PluginNetworkService.fetch.
# Change the policy in both repos and this table together; whichever side was
# not updated fails its test.
#
# Format: one case per line, "<expectation> <header-name>". Names are matched
# case-insensitively, so mixed case here is deliberate.
#   keep             request header a plugin may set; sent as-is. Exactly the
#                    allowlist, one row per allowlisted name.
#   drop-credential  request header dropped AND classified as a credential
#   drop             request header dropped, not credential-looking
#   response-strip   response header removed before the plugin sees it
#   response-keep    response header passed through

# The allowlist (doc 30 §2.2 plus Accept-Language).
keep Accept
keep accept-language
keep Content-Type
keep IF-NONE-MATCH
keep If-Modified-Since

# Named credential headers (doc 30 §2.2 "host-only").
drop-credential Authorization
drop-credential Proxy-Authorization
drop-credential Cookie
drop-credential X-API-Key
drop-credential API-Key
drop-credential API-Sign
drop-credential CB-ACCESS-KEY
drop-credential CB-ACCESS-SIGN
drop-credential CB-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP
drop-credential CB-ACCESS-PASSPHRASE
drop-credential OK-ACCESS-KEY
drop-credential OK-ACCESS-SIGN
drop-credential OK-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP
drop-credential OK-ACCESS-PASSPHRASE
drop-credential X-MBX-APIKEY

# Credential patterns: a prefix, or a name containing auth, cookie, key,
# secret, sign, token, passphrase, password, session or cert.
drop-credential cb-access-anything
drop-credential ok-access-anything
drop-credential X-Auth-Token
drop-credential X-Custom-Secret
drop-credential X-Signature
drop-credential Access-Token
drop-credential AccessKey
drop-credential Token
drop-credential X-Passphrase
drop-credential X-Session-Id
drop-credential X-Password
drop-credential X-Client-Cert
drop-credential X-Api-Key-Id
drop-credential X-Cookie-Consent
drop-credential WWW-Authenticate

# Host-controlled and unknown headers.
drop Host
drop Content-Length
drop Transfer-Encoding
drop Connection
drop User-Agent
drop X-Request-Id
drop Origin
drop Referer
drop Accept-Encoding
drop Cache-Control
drop X-Forwarded-For
# The reserved credential-handle header (doc 30 §4.6) is not allowlisted. The
# in-host wasi:http@0.2 path goes further and refuses the whole request.
drop x-hellohq-credential

# Response headers.
response-strip Set-Cookie
response-strip set-cookie2
response-strip SET-COOKIE
response-keep content-type
response-keep etag
response-keep Cache-Control
